column3: The opt1 CLI self-compile includes the added Linux x86-64 assembler, scalar and SIMD encoders, and ELF object emission code. Same-host Cachegrind on identical paths measured 113,700,759,621 Ir at 646b85bb2 and 116,716,669,427 Ir at 996339667, a cost of +3,015,909,806 Ir. The Linux-2 lane in hosted run 46081871269 was cancelled before it published a self-compile measurement.
